_doc: random_initializer: replaces a sequence with random notes in the track's scale, or a borrowed scale. Copy this file to your setup folder and change any value; keys starting with _ are comments.
_density: Share of the sequence's steps that receive a note. 0 produces an empty sequence; 1 fills every step.
_intensity_gain: A longer knob turn adds this much density per intensity level beyond the first.
_scale_source: "own": the track's scale; "auto": its own, or borrowed from the first other track with a scale; or a track number to borrow from.
_fallback_scale: No scale on any track: "pattern" infers one from existing notes (if possible), or "chromatic" permits all pitch classes.
_note_range: Inclusive MIDI pitch range for generated notes (60 is C4).
_max_leap: Largest interval in semitones from the preceding generated note, when the scale and range allow it.
_avoid_repeat: Avoid repeating the preceding pitch, when another nearby in-scale note is available.
_length_steps: Inclusive note-length range in sequence steps. A note is shortened before the next occupied step.
_polyphony: On chord tracks, chance to add a scale-note third or fifth above the main note.
_seed: null: different every time; a number: repeatable results.
